<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Barbearia Fracaroli</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,500&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --black:#0b0908;
    --charcoal:#171310;
    --charcoal-2:#1f1a15;
    --gold:#c9a227;
    --gold-light:#e8c468;
    --ivory:#f3ecdd;
    --ivory-dim:#cbc0aa;
    --line:#3b2f22;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--black);
    color:var(--ivory);
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }

  h1,h2,h3{
    font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    margin:0;
    color:var(--ivory);
  }

  .accent{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style:italic;
    color:var(--gold-light);
  }

  a{color:inherit;}

  .wrap{
    max-width:1040px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:0 24px;
  }

  /* NAV */
  header{
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    z-index:50;
    background:rgba(11,9,8,0.86);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  nav.wrap{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    height:72px;
  }
  .brandmark{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size:22px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
  }
  .brandmark img{height:34px;width:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5));}
  .navlinks{
    display:flex;
    gap:32px;
    font-size:14px;
    font-weight:500;
  }
  .navlinks a{
    text-decoration:none;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    position:relative;
    padding:4px 0;
    transition:color .2s ease;
  }
  .navlinks a:hover{color:var(--gold-light);}
  .navlinks a::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    left:0; bottom:-2px;
    width:0; height:1px;
    background:var(--gold);
    transition:width .25s ease;
  }
  .navlinks a:hover::after{width:100%;}
  .navcta{
    display:inline-block;
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    color:var(--gold-light);
    padding:9px 18px;
    border-radius:2px;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
    transition:background .2s ease, color .2s ease;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .navcta:hover{background:var(--gold); color:var(--black);}
  .menu-toggle{display:none;}

  /* HERO */
  .hero{
    position:relative;
    padding:72px 24px 88px;
    text-align:center;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    top:-20%; left:50%;
    width:900px; height:900px;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(201,162,39,0.16) 0%, rgba(201,162,39,0) 62%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-inner{
    position:relative;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(16px);
    animation:rise 900ms ease forwards 150ms;
  }
  @keyframes rise{ to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} }
  .hero-logo{
    width:220px;
    max-width:60vw;
    height:auto;
    margin-bottom:8px;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 46px rgba(201,162,39,0.16));
  }
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(40px, 8vw, 74px);
    line-height:0.95;
  }
  .hero .accent-line{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:clamp(18px, 2.6vw, 24px);
    color:var(--gold-light);
    margin-top:18px;
    max-width:520px;
  }
  .hero-buttons{
    margin-top:34px;
    display:flex;
    gap:16px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    justify-content:center;
  }
  .btn-primary, .btn-secondary{
    padding:14px 30px;
    border-radius:2px;
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:600;
    text-decoration:none;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    transition:transform .18s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease;
    display:inline-block;
  }
  .btn-primary{
    background:var(--gold);
    color:var(--black);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--gold-light); transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .btn-secondary{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    color:var(--ivory);
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--gold); color:var(--gold-light);}

  /* DIVIDER */
  .divider{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:6px 0 0;
  }
  .divider svg{width:280px; height:auto; opacity:0.85;}

  /* SECTION GENERIC */
  section{padding:84px 24px;}
  .section-head{
    text-align:center;
    max-width:560px;
    margin:0 auto 48px;
  }
  .section-head .kicker{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style:italic;
    color:var(--gold-light);
    font-size:19px;
    display:block;
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .section-head h2{
    font-size:clamp(32px, 5vw, 46px);
  }
  .section-head p{
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    margin-top:14px;
    line-height:1.6;
    font-size:15px;
  }

  /* SERVICES */
  .service-groups{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap:40px;
    max-width:960px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .service-group h3{
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--gold);
    margin-bottom:18px;
    padding-bottom:12px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .service-row{
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    gap:6px;
    padding:11px 0;
    border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line);
  }
  .service-row .name{
    font-size:15.5px;
    color:var(--ivory);
  }
  .service-row .fill{
    flex:1;
    border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line);
    transform:translateY(-4px);
    margin:0 2px;
  }
  .service-row .price{
    font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size:19px;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
    color:var(--gold-light);
    white-space:nowrap;
  }

  /* ABOUT */
  .about{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:56px;
    align-items:center;
    max-width:960px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .about-visual{
    position:relative;
  }
  .cuts-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:14px;
  }
  .cuts-grid img{
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:1/1;
    object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:2px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:block;
  }
  .about-text .kicker{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style:italic;
    color:var(--gold-light);
    font-size:19px;
    display:block;
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .about-text h2{
    font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,42px);
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  .about-text p{
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    line-height:1.7;
    font-size:15px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .about-stats{
    display:flex;
    gap:32px;
    margin-top:26px;
  }
  .about-stats div strong{
    display:block;
    font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size:30px;
    color:var(--gold-light);
  }
  .about-stats div span{
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
  }

  /* BOOKING */
  .booking-box{
    max-width:560px;
    margin:0 auto;
    background:var(--charcoal);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:2px;
    padding:40px 36px;
  }
  .field{
    margin-bottom:20px;
    text-align:left;
  }
  .field label{
    display:block;
    font-size:12.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .field select, .field input{
    width:100%;
    background:var(--black);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    color:var(--ivory);
    padding:13px 14px;
    font-size:15px;
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    border-radius:2px;
    outline:none;
    transition:border-color .2s ease;
  }
  .field select:focus, .field input:focus{border-color:var(--gold);}
  .field-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:16px;
  }
  .booking-total{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:baseline;
    padding:16px 0;
    margin-bottom:22px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .booking-total span:first-child{
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .booking-total span:last-child{
    font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size:26px;
    color:var(--gold-light);
  }
  .whatsapp-btn{
    width:100%;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:10px;
    background:var(--gold);
    color:var(--black);
    border:none;
    padding:16px;
    font-size:16px;
    font-weight:700;
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    border-radius:2px;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
  }
  .whatsapp-btn:hover{background:var(--gold-light);}
  .whatsapp-btn:active{transform:scale(0.98);}
  .whatsapp-btn svg{width:20px; height:20px; flex-shrink:0;}
  .booking-note{
    text-align:center;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    margin-top:16px;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  .cancel-box{
    margin-top:28px;
    padding-top:22px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .cancel-box summary{
    color:var(--gold-light);
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    text-align:center;
    list-style-position:inside;
  }
  .cancel-box summary:hover{color:var(--ivory);}
  .cancel-form{
    margin-top:20px;
  }
  .cancel-form .field{margin-bottom:16px;}
  .cancel-fields{
    display:block;
  }
  .cancel-form .calendar-box{margin-top:8px;}
  .cancel-form .time-grid{margin-top:8px;}
  .cancel-form .field-error{margin:0 0 16px;}
  .cancel-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:transparent;
    color:var(--gold-light);
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    padding:13px 16px;
    font-size:14px;
    font-weight:600;
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    border-radius:2px;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .2s ease, color .2s ease;
  }
  .cancel-btn:hover{background:var(--gold); color:var(--black);}
  .field-error{
    color:#e08b6b;
    font-size:12.5px;
    margin-top:6px;
    display:none;
  }
  .label-hint{
    text-transform:none;
    font-weight:400;
    letter-spacing:0;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    font-size:12px;
  }

  /* SERVICES CHECKLIST */
  .services-list{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:2px;
    padding:6px 14px;
    max-height:280px;
    overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .service-group-label{
    font-size:11.5px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0.1em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--gold);
    padding:12px 0 6px;
  }
  .service-group-label:first-child{padding-top:10px;}
  .service-check{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    padding:9px 0;
    border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line);
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:14.5px;
  }
  .service-check:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .service-check input{
    width:16px;
    height:16px;
    accent-color:var(--gold);
    flex-shrink:0;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .sc-name{flex:1; color:var(--ivory);}
  .sc-price{color:var(--gold-light); font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .service-check:has(input:checked){background:rgba(201,162,39,0.07);}

  /* CALENDAR */
  .calendar-box{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:2px;
    padding:16px;
  }
  .calendar-header{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    margin-bottom:12px;
    font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size:17px;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    color:var(--ivory);
  }
  .cal-nav{
    background:none;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    color:var(--gold-light);
    width:30px;
    height:30px;
    border-radius:2px;
    font-size:16px;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease;
  }
  .cal-nav:hover{border-color:var(--gold); color:var(--gold);}
  .cal-nav:disabled{opacity:0.3; cursor:not-allowed;}
  .calendar-weekdays{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(7, 1fr);
    text-align:center;
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .calendar-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(7, 1fr);
    gap:4px;
  }
  .cal-day{
    aspect-ratio:1/1;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:13.5px;
    border-radius:2px;
    background:transparent;
    border:1px solid transparent;
    color:var(--ivory);
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
  }
  .cal-day.empty{cursor:default;}
  .cal-day.disabled{color:var(--line); cursor:not-allowed;}
  .cal-day:not(.disabled):not(.empty):hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
  .cal-day.selected{background:var(--gold); color:var(--black); font-weight:700;}

  /* TIME GRID */
  .time-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap:8px;
  }
  .time-slot{
    padding:10px 4px;
    text-align:center;
    font-size:13.5px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:2px;
    color:var(--ivory);
    background:transparent;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease;
  }
  .time-slot:hover:not(.taken){border-color:var(--gold);}
  .time-slot.selected{background:var(--gold); color:var(--black); font-weight:700; border-color:var(--gold);}
  .time-slot.taken{
    color:var(--line);
    text-decoration:line-through;
    cursor:not-allowed;
    border-color:var(--line);
  }
  .time-grid-empty{
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    font-size:13px;
    padding:10px 0;
  }
  @media(max-width:480px){
    .time-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);}
  }

  /* MAP */
  .map-frame{
    max-width:760px;
    margin:0 auto;
    aspect-ratio:16/8;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:2px;
    overflow:hidden;
    filter:grayscale(0.15) contrast(1.05);
  }
  .map-link{
    display:block;
    width:fit-content;
    margin:20px auto 0;
    font-size:13.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
    color:var(--gold-light);
    text-decoration:none;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold);
    padding-bottom:2px;
    transition:color .2s ease;
  }
  .map-link:hover{color:var(--ivory);}

  /* FOOTER */
  footer{
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:52px 24px 32px;
  }
  .footer-inner{
    max-width:1040px;
    margin:0 auto;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:32px;
  }
  .footer-brand{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .footer-brand img{height:40px;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.55));}
  .footer-brand span{
    font-family:'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size:20px;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
  }
  .footer-contacts{
    display:flex;
    gap:48px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .footer-contacts div h4{
    font-size:12px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    color:var(--gold);
    margin-bottom:10px;
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
  }
  .footer-contacts a{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
    text-decoration:none;
    font-size:14.5px;
    margin-bottom:8px;
    transition:color .2s ease;
  }
  .footer-contacts a:hover{color:var(--gold-light);}
  .footer-contacts svg{width:16px; height:16px;}
  .footer-bottom{
    max-width:1040px;
    margin:40px auto 0;
    padding-top:24px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    text-align:center;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--ivory-dim);
  }

  @media(max-width: 820px){
    .wrap{padding-left:20px; padding-right:20px;}
    nav.wrap{height:64px;}
    .brandmark{font-size:20px;}
    .brandmark img{height:30px;}
    .navlinks{display:none;}
    .navcta{padding:8px 12px; font-size:12px;}
    .about{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .service-groups{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:36px;}
    .field-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .footer-inner{gap:28px;}
    .footer-contacts{gap:28px;}
  }

  @media(max-width: 560px){
    .wrap{padding-left:16px; padding-right:16px;}
    .hero{padding:48px 16px 58px;}
    .hero-logo{width:180px;}
    .hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px, 13vw, 58px);}
    .hero .accent-line{font-size:19px; margin-top:14px;}
    .hero-buttons{width:100%; margin-top:26px; gap:10px;}
    .btn-primary, .btn-secondary{width:100%; padding:13px 18px;}
    section{padding:58px 16px;}
    .section-head{margin-bottom:34px;}
    .section-head h2{font-size:38px;}
    .section-head p{font-size:14px;}
    .service-groups{gap:28px;}
    .service-row{gap:4px;}
    .service-row .name{font-size:14px;}
    .service-row .price{font-size:17px;}
    .booking-box{padding:24px 16px;}
    .calendar-box{padding:10px;}
    .calendar-header{font-size:15px;}
    .cal-day{font-size:12px;}
    .time-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:6px;}
    .time-slot{font-size:12px; padding:10px 2px;}
    .about{gap:32px;}
    .about-stats{gap:20px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
    .map-frame{aspect-ratio:4/3;}
    footer{padding:40px 16px 24px;}
    .footer-inner{display:block;}
    .footer-brand{margin-bottom:28px;}
    .footer-contacts{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:20px;}
    .footer-bottom{margin-top:32px; padding-top:20px;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <nav class="wrap">
    <div class="brandmark">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Barbearia Fracaroli">
      FRACAROLI
    </div>
    <div class="navlinks">
      <a href="#servicos">Serviços</a>
      <a href="#sobre">Sobre</a>
      <a href="#agendar">Agendar</a>
      <a href="#localizacao">Localização</a>
      <a href="#contato">Contato</a>
    </div>
    <a href="#agendar" class="navcta">Agendar horário</a>
  </nav>
</header>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Barbearia Fracaroli">
    <h1>BARBEARIA<br>FRACAROLI</h1>
    <p class="accent-line">Tradição de navalha e tesoura, num corte pensado do jeito que você gosta.</p>
    <div class="hero-buttons">
      <a href="#agendar" class="btn-primary">Agendar meu horário</a>
      <a href="#servicos" class="btn-secondary">Ver tabela de preços</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 300 40" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <path d="M0 20 C 40 4, 70 4, 95 20 C 118 34, 128 34, 150 20" fill="none" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <path d="M300 20 C 260 4, 230 4, 205 20 C 182 34, 172 34, 150 20" fill="none" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="1.4"/>

<script>
  const nomeEl = document.getElementById('nome');
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('total-preco');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-agendar');
  const cancelForm = document.getElementById('cancel-form');
  const cancelNomeEl = document.getElementById('cancel-nome');
  const cancelDataEl = document.getElementById('cancel-data');
  const cancelHorarioEl = document.getElementById('cancel-horario');

  const OWNER_PHONE = '5511951195786';
  const MESES = ['Janeiro','Fevereiro','Março','Abril','Maio','Junho','Julho','Agosto','Setembro','Outubro','Novembro','Dezembro'];
  const CLOSED_WEEKDAYS = [0, 1]; // domingo e segunda fechados

  const hojeReal = new Date();
  hojeReal.setHours(0,0,0,0);

  let calViewYear = hojeReal.getFullYear();
  let calViewMonth = hojeReal.getMonth();
  let selectedDateISO = null;
  let selectedTime = null;
  let cancelCalViewYear = hojeReal.getFullYear();
  let cancelCalViewMonth = hojeReal.getMonth();
  let cancelSelectedDateISO = null;
  let cancelSelectedTime = null;

  const MAX_MONTHS_AHEAD = 3;

  function isoOf(y, m, d){
    return `${y}-${String(m+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  }

  document.querySelector('.cancel-box').addEventListener('toggle', function(){
    if(!this.open) return;
    if(selectedDateISO && !cancelSelectedDateISO){
      cancelSelectedDateISO = selectedDateISO;
      cancelCalViewYear = Number(selectedDateISO.slice(0, 4));
      cancelCalViewMonth = Number(selectedDateISO.slice(5, 7)) - 1;
    }
    if(selectedTime && !cancelSelectedTime) cancelSelectedTime = selectedTime;
    if(nomeEl.value.trim() && !cancelNomeEl.value) cancelNomeEl.value = nomeEl.value.trim();
    renderCancelCalendar();
    renderCancelTimeSlots();
  });

  function getBookings(iso){
    try{
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('fracaroli_bookings_' + iso);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    }catch(e){ return []; }
  }

  function addBooking(iso, time){
    const atual = getBookings(iso);
    atual.push(time);
    localStorage.setItem('fracaroli_bookings_' + iso, JSON.stringify(atual));
  }

  function removeBooking(iso, time){
    const atual = getBookings(iso);
    const indice = atual.indexOf(time);
    if(indice === -1) return false;
    atual.splice(indice, 1);
    localStorage.setItem('fracaroli_bookings_' + iso, JSON.stringify(atual));
    return true;
  }

  function renderCalendar(){
    const grid = document.getElementById('cal-grid');
    const label = document.getElementById('cal-month-label');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    label.textContent = `${MESES[calViewMonth]} ${calViewYear}`;

    const firstDay = new Date(calViewYear, calViewMonth, 1);
    const startWeekday = firstDay.getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(calViewYear, calViewMonth + 1, 0).getDate();

    for(let i = 0; i < startWeekday; i++){
      const empty = document.createElement('div');
      empty.className = 'cal-day empty';
      grid.appendChild(empty);
    }

    for(let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++){
      const cell = document.createElement('button');
      cell.type = 'button';
      cell.className = 'cal-day';
      cell.textContent = d;

      const thisDate = new Date(calViewYear, calViewMonth, d);
      thisDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);
      const weekday = thisDate.getDay();
      const iso = isoOf(calViewYear, calViewMonth, d);

      const isPast = thisDate < hojeReal;
      const isClosed = CLOSED_WEEKDAYS.includes(weekday);

      if(isPast || isClosed){
        cell.classList.add('disabled');
        cell.disabled = true;
      } else {
        cell.addEventListener('click', function(){
          selectedDateISO = iso;
          selectedTime = null;
          document.querySelectorAll('#cal-grid .cal-day.selected').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('selected'); });
          cell.classList.add('selected');
          showError('data', false);
          renderTimeSlots();
        });
      }

      if(iso === selectedDateISO){
        cell.classList.add('selected');
      }

      grid.appendChild(cell);
    }

    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('cal-prev');
    const isCurrentMonth = (calViewYear === hojeReal.getFullYear() && calViewMonth === hojeReal.getMonth());
    prevBtn.disabled = isCurrentMonth;

    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('cal-next');
    const monthsAhead = (calViewYear - hojeReal.getFullYear()) * 12 + (calViewMonth - hojeReal.getMonth());
    nextBtn.disabled = monthsAhead >= MAX_MONTHS_AHEAD;
  }

  function renderCancelCalendar(){
    const grid = document.getElementById('cancel-cal-grid');
    const label = document.getElementById('cancel-cal-month-label');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    label.textContent = `${MESES[cancelCalViewMonth]} ${cancelCalViewYear}`;

    const firstDay = new Date(cancelCalViewYear, cancelCalViewMonth, 1);
    const startWeekday = firstDay.getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(cancelCalViewYear, cancelCalViewMonth + 1, 0).getDate();

    for(let i = 0; i < startWeekday; i++){
      const empty = document.createElement('div');
      empty.className = 'cal-day empty';
      grid.appendChild(empty);
    }

    for(let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++){
      const cell = document.createElement('button');
      cell.type = 'button';
      cell.className = 'cal-day';
      cell.textContent = d;

      const thisDate = new Date(cancelCalViewYear, cancelCalViewMonth, d);
      thisDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);
      const weekday = thisDate.getDay();
      const iso = isoOf(cancelCalViewYear, cancelCalViewMonth, d);

      if(thisDate < hojeReal || CLOSED_WEEKDAYS.includes(weekday)){
        cell.classList.add('disabled');
        cell.disabled = true;
      } else {
        cell.addEventListener('click', function(){
          cancelSelectedDateISO = iso;
          cancelSelectedTime = null;
          cancelDataEl.value = iso;
          cancelHorarioEl.value = '';
          document.querySelectorAll('#cancel-cal-grid .cal-day.selected').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('selected'); });
          cell.classList.add('selected');
          document.getElementById('cancel-selection-error').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('cancel-not-found-error').style.display = 'none';
          renderCancelTimeSlots();
        });
      }

      if(iso === cancelSelectedDateISO) cell.classList.add('selected');
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    }

    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-cal-prev');
    const isCurrentMonth = (cancelCalViewYear === hojeReal.getFullYear() && cancelCalViewMonth === hojeReal.getMonth());
    prevBtn.disabled = isCurrentMonth;

    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-cal-next');
    const monthsAhead = (cancelCalViewYear - hojeReal.getFullYear()) * 12 + (cancelCalViewMonth - hojeReal.getMonth());
    nextBtn.disabled = monthsAhead >= MAX_MONTHS_AHEAD;
  }

  function renderCancelTimeSlots(){
    const container = document.getElementById('cancel-time-grid');
    container.innerHTML = '';

    if(!cancelSelectedDateISO){
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'time-grid-empty';
      msg.textContent = 'Escolha uma data para ver os horários ocupados.';
      container.appendChild(msg);
      return;
    }

    const ocupados = getBookings(cancelSelectedDateISO);
    const slots = [];
    for(let h = 9; h < 20; h++){
      for(const m of [0, 30]){
        slots.push(`${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`);
      }
    }

    slots.forEach(function(time){
      const slot = document.createElement('button');
      slot.type = 'button';
      slot.className = 'time-slot';
      slot.textContent = time;

      if(!ocupados.includes(time)){
        slot.classList.add('taken');
        slot.disabled = true;
      } else {
        if(time === cancelSelectedTime) slot.classList.add('selected');
        slot.addEventListener('click', function(){
          cancelSelectedTime = time;
          cancelHorarioEl.value = time;
          document.querySelectorAll('#cancel-time-grid .time-slot.selected').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('selected'); });
          slot.classList.add('selected');
          document.getElementById('cancel-selection-error').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('cancel-not-found-error').style.display = 'none';
        });
      }
      container.appendChild(slot);
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('cal-prev').addEventListener('click', function(){
    calViewMonth--;
    if(calViewMonth < 0){ calViewMonth = 11; calViewYear--; }
    renderCalendar();
  });
  document.getElementById('cal-next').addEventListener('click', function(){
    calViewMonth++;
    if(calViewMonth > 11){ calViewMonth = 0; calViewYear++; }
    renderCalendar();
  });

  document.getElementById('cancel-cal-prev').addEventListener('click', function(){
    cancelCalViewMonth--;
    if(cancelCalViewMonth < 0){ cancelCalViewMonth = 11; cancelCalViewYear--; }
    renderCancelCalendar();
  });
  document.getElementById('cancel-cal-next').addEventListener('click', function(){
    cancelCalViewMonth++;
    if(cancelCalViewMonth > 11){ cancelCalViewMonth = 0; cancelCalViewYear++; }
    renderCancelCalendar();
  });

  function renderTimeSlots(){
    const container = document.getElementById('time-grid');
    container.innerHTML = '';

    if(!selectedDateISO){
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'time-grid-empty';
      msg.textContent = 'Escolha uma data para ver os horários.';
      container.appendChild(msg);
      return;
    }

    const ocupados = getBookings(selectedDateISO);
    const slots = [];
    for(let h = 9; h < 20; h++){
      for(const m of [0, 30]){
        slots.push(`${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`);
      }
    }

    slots.forEach(function(time){
      const btnEl = document.createElement('button');
      btnEl.type = 'button';
      btnEl.className = 'time-slot';
      btnEl.textContent = time;

      if(ocupados.includes(time)){
        btnEl.classList.add('taken');
        btnEl.disabled = true;
      } else {
        if(time === selectedTime) btnEl.classList.add('selected');
        btnEl.addEventListener('click', function(){
          selectedTime = time;
          showError('horario', false);
          document.querySelectorAll('.time-slot.selected').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('selected'); });
          btnEl.classList.add('selected');
        });
      }
      container.appendChild(btnEl);
    });
  }

  renderCalendar();
  renderTimeSlots();
  renderCancelCalendar();
  renderCancelTimeSlots();

  function getSelectedServices(){
    const checks = document.querySelectorAll('#services-list input[type="checkbox"]:checked');
    return Array.from(checks).map(function(c){
      return { name: c.value, price: Number(c.getAttribute('data-price')) };
    });
  }

  function updateTotal(){
    const selecionados = getSelectedServices();
    if(selecionados.length === 0){
      totalEl.textContent = 'R$ —';
      return;
    }
    const soma = selecionados.reduce(function(acc, s){ return acc + s.price; }, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = 'R$ ' + soma;
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('#services-list input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(chk){
    chk.addEventListener('change', function(){
      updateTotal();
      if(getSelectedServices().length > 0) showError('servico', false);
    });
  });

  function showError(fieldId, show){
    const err = document.getElementById('err-' + fieldId);
    if(err) err.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
  }

  function formatDateBR(isoDate){
    if(!isoDate) return '';
    const [y,m,d] = isoDate.split('-');
    return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
  }

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    let valid = true;

    const servicos = getSelectedServices();
    if(servicos.length === 0){ showError('servico', true); valid = false; } else { showError('servico', false); }
    if(!selectedDateISO){ showError('data', true); valid = false; } else { showError('data', false); }
    if(!selectedTime){ showError('horario', true); valid = false; } else { showError('horario', false); }
    if(!nomeEl.value.trim()){ showError('nome', true); valid = false; } else { showError('nome', false); }

    if(!valid) return;

    // Revalida na hora de confirmar: o horário pode ter sido ocupado neste navegador
    // enquanto o cliente preenchia o formulário.
    const ocupadosAgora = getBookings(selectedDateISO);
    if(ocupadosAgora.includes(selectedTime)){
      showError('horario', true);
      renderTimeSlots();
      return;
    }

    const somaTotal = servicos.reduce(function(acc, s){ return acc + s.price; }, 0);
    const listaServicos = servicos.map(function(s){ return `- ${s.name} (R$ ${s.price})`; }).join('\n');
    const dataBR = formatDateBR(selectedDateISO);

    const mensagem =
`Olá! Gostaria de confirmar meu horário na Barbearia Fracaroli.

Serviços:
${listaServicos}

Total estimado: R$ ${somaTotal}
Data: ${dataBR}
Horário: ${selectedTime}
Nome: ${nomeEl.value.trim()}`;

    addBooking(selectedDateISO, selectedTime);
    renderTimeSlots();

    const url = `https://wa.me/${OWNER_PHONE}?text=${encodeURIComponent(mensagem)}`;
    window.open(url, '_blank');
  });

  cancelForm.addEventListener('submit', function(event){
    event.preventDefault();

    const data = cancelSelectedDateISO;
    const horario = cancelSelectedTime;
    const nome = cancelNomeEl.value.trim();

    if(!data || !horario){
      document.getElementById('cancel-selection-error').style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    if(!getBookings(data).includes(horario)){
      document.getElementById('cancel-not-found-error').style.display = 'block';
      renderCancelTimeSlots();
      return;
    }

    const mensagem =
`Olá! Preciso solicitar o cancelamento de um agendamento na Barbearia Fracaroli.

Nome: ${nome}
Data: ${formatDateBR(data)}
Horário: ${horario}`;

    removeBooking(data, horario);
    if(selectedDateISO === data){
      if(selectedTime === horario) selectedTime = null;
      renderTimeSlots();
    }

    const url = `https://wa.me/${OWNER_PHONE}?text=${encodeURIComponent(mensagem)}`;
    window.open(url, '_blank');
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>
